today.title: Today
today.baiTodayText: There is no BAX or BAL today. Every agent is allowed and bosses appear one after another.
today.resetBefore: Today is the weekly reset day: until 10 PM (Brasília) the score still counts for the current week.
today.resetAfter: Weekly reset done at 10 PM (Brasília): the score now counts for the new week.

help.title: How to use
help.text1: The battle day turns over at 12 PM (Brasília). The weekly score reset happens at 10 PM on the last day of the week.
help.text2: Tap BAX or BAL and then a day to see the full Meta team.

grid.title: {{mode}} · Cycle days
grid.subtitle: 24 days per cycle. Days 3, 10, 17 and 24 belong to BAI.

help.title: Day grid
help.text1: Each card shows the day restriction and the Solo of the primary Meta team.

detail.title: {{mode}} · Day {{day}}
detail.notFound: This day does not exist for BAX/BAL (days 3, 10, 17 and 24 belong to BAI).

help.title: Day team
help.text1: The restriction defines which agents can be used. Criteria joined by "+" must all apply.
help.text2: Each agent shows the Meta uniform and the recommended CTP with its quality.

free.title: BAL · Free mode
free.subtitle: Best performing teams with no character restriction.

help.title: Free mode
help.text1: Any agent can be used in free BAL. These teams change rarely.

myTeam.title: My team
myTeam.subtitle: Build your team with the agents you own that meet the restriction.
myTeam.noCandidates: No agent from your roster meets this day's restriction.

suggestion.title: Suggestion for your roster
suggestion.text: Best possible team with what you own: Sword Brazil's Meta, Alternatives and reserves, in that order.
suggestion.none: No suggestion yet: none of your agents is in this day's teams or reserves.

help.title: My team
help.text1: Green: same as Meta. Amber: different. Red: you don't own the Meta agent or uniform.
help.text2: Your choices are saved on this device (and in your account, if you sign in).

palette.title: CTPs
palette.hint: Drag a CTP onto an agent of your team, or tap the CTP and then the agent.
palette.armed: CTP selected: tap an agent to apply.

dnd.instructions: To pick up a CTP, press space or enter. Use the arrow keys to move and space or enter to drop it on an agent. Esc cancels.
dnd.dropNone: CTP {{name}} dropped outside an agent. Nothing changed.

myTeam.copyNone: You don't own any agent of this team. Build it with your roster.

freePick.label: Pick from every character
freePick.help: No roster needed: unlocks the whole catalog to build your teams. Each day's restrictions still apply.
